title: A halt or a unhappy glance when another person weeps
summary: By about 2 years, most children register that someone else is harmed or distressed, the milestone sheet says, for instance by stopping or looking unhappy.
body: Stopping for a moment, or wearing a sorrowful glance, while another person weeps is the picture sheet gives for this second-year line. The skill is registering another person's distress. The line does not ask the child to mend it. The publisher's majority for the series is at least three in four, the sheet is not a diagnosis, and the birthday is the American one.

sources.title: Milestones by 2 Years
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US government public domain. Supports 'Notices when others are hurt or upset, like pausing or looking sad when someone is crying'.
